name: Code Feature Split
solves: Feature work that can be split across implementation and test/documentation lanes
Parallelizable changes with a shared parent acceptance contract

phases.task: Define the shared feature contract, write boundaries, and acceptance checks.
Build the feature behavior inside the implementation boundary.
Add focused tests or fixtures for the shared feature contract.
acceptance: Tests cover the parent acceptance criteria

parent_acceptance: Implementation and tests agree on the same contract
Any cross-worker conflicts are resolved by the parent
